title: 李开复·零一万物：中国硬件迭代更快，下一代设备不是手机？
speaker: Kai-Fu Lee

segments.en: Oh, yeah, the phone and PC will continue to be used for AI, but they were built for different interfaces and different applications and purposes. And that legacy isn't the ideal device.
segments.zh: 哦对，手机和PC会继续用于AI，但它们是为不同的界面、应用和目的而建的。这种历史包袱不是理想设备。

segments.en: The ideal device should be speech-driven, therefore should be always on, always listening, so that I don't have to push a bunch of buttons to issue a command to my agent.
segments.zh: 理想设备应该是语音驱动的，因此应该始终在线、始终倾听，这样我就不必按一堆按钮来向智能体下指令。

segments.en: And once it's always on, always listening and speech-driven, it will also have an infinite memory. It will store everything it hears and it will become smaller and smaller.
segments.zh: 一旦它始终在线、始终倾听、语音驱动，它还会有无限记忆。它会存储听到的一切，并且变得越来越小。

segments.en: So that obviously brings up some concerns that in certain countries it might be hard to gain adoption.
segments.zh: 所以这显然引发一些担忧，在某些国家可能很难被采用。

segments.en: But I would argue that China probably would move forward with this kind of device and gain some kind of advantage and the higher likelihood to invent the next iPhone, so to speak. But it's not a phone.
segments.zh: 但我认为中国可能会推进这类设备，并获得某种优势，更有可能发明下一个iPhone，可以这么说。但它不是手机。

segments.en: In other words, is it a physical device? What is it invisible? Is it you carried around? Yeah, how close are we to this? It's not a science fiction.
segments.zh: 换句话说，它是实体设备吗？还是隐形的？是你随身携带的吗？对，我们离这有多近？这不是科幻。

segments.en: We've invested in companies, the innovation that build tiny devices, you know, the small that can be a pin or a wristband is becoming invisible. Right. It won't be fully invisible, of course. It also could be glasses, watches, and so on.
segments.zh: 我们投资了一些公司，它们制造微型设备，小到可以是一枚别针或腕带，正变得隐形。对，当然不会完全隐形。它也可能是眼镜、手表等等。

segments.en: Okay, how do we need to be looking at competition that you mentioned China might be ahead on this? The US side is doing its own thing.
segments.zh: 好，我们该如何看待竞争？你提到中国在这方面可能领先？美国也在做自己的事。

segments.en: Yeah, I think China is just better in manufacturing, supply chain, and cost management and faster iterations for hardware, whether it's robotics or hardware devices.
segments.zh: 对，我认为中国在制造、供应链、成本管理以及硬件更快迭代方面就是更强，无论是机器人还是硬件设备。

segments.en: And when iPhone was invented, only US had the software, hardware, systems, design skills. So that opportunity belonged to the US. But now China has equal or even better skills plus a stronger hardware manufacturing ecosystem that allows faster iterations.
segments.zh: 当iPhone被发明时，只有美国拥有软件、硬件、系统和设计能力。所以那个机会属于美国。但现在中国有同等甚至更好的能力，加上更强大的硬件制造生态，允许更快迭代。

segments.en: So I think it's extremely likely the AI native device will come from China.
segments.zh: 所以我认为AI原生设备极有可能来自中国。
